entries.subject: DAMIT 5741: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 5741, version 2019-10-23, pole (147°, 25°), period 17.2595 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 126.473 ± 1.298 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 126.473 ± 1.298 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "63.24 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 369, DAMIT model 5741 diameter 123 ± 3 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 5741 fitted to 4 occultations); the shown value is kept.

entries.subject: Tanete whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 21 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.959 at 462 nm, 1.012 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#2f2f2d in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 2.8% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.2%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2012, ApJ 759, L8; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
